mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in WORKPLACES mobility over the past four weeks signals a return to more regular commuting and office-based routines, which directly translates to increased footfall in retail and recreation venues over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES mobility continuing its upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week rebound in transit station activity, as observed in the latest data, indicates renewed public confidence in using shared transport, which will lead to higher retail and recreation engagement over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT increases by more than 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the two weeks following a week-on-week TRANSIT increase exceeding 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: The inverse relationship between increasing WORKPLACES mobility and decreasing RESIDENTIAL mobility signifies a clear shift from home-centric activities to out-of-home engagement, which will directly boost retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES increases and RESIDENTIAL decreases concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: The recent rebound in PARKS mobility, occurring in mid-September, suggests the end of the monsoon season in Delhi, encouraging more outdoor activities and subsequently driving up general retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:Decision time point 2022-09-15 (end of monsoon season in Delhi)
failure_condition: PARKS mobility increases or remains stable, but RETAIL_REC does not improve over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility over the past four weeks indicates a general reduction in essential errands, which often precedes or accompanies a broader reduction in discretionary retail and recreation spending over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next four weeks despite a continued decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week increase in RETAIL_REC, even if modest, indicates a positive momentum shift in consumer behavior that is likely to continue for at least the immediate next week as confidence builds.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines in the immediate next week after showing a week-on-week increase.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent week-on-week rebound in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility signifies a strong return to daily commuting and out-of-home activities, creating more opportunities for retail and recreation engagement over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both show week-on-week increases
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decreases over the next two weeks despite concurrent week-on-week increases in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility over the past four weeks, in the absence of new lockdown policies, indicates a loosening of restrictions or a behavioral shift towards more outdoor activity, which will boost retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL declines for at least two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks even as RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to fall and no new restrictions are imposed.
